title: Udaipur Jawai (2N/3D)
reportingPoint: Gurugram. The group departs in the evening; final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.
overview:
The City of Lakes and leopard country from Gurugram: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** group trip covers Lake Pichola, City Palace, Jagdish Temple and Gangaur Ghat, an adrenaline-rush leopard jeep safari at Jawai, Fateh Sagar and Saheliyon ki Bari.

You leave Gurugram in the evening by AC deluxe bus or traveller. Day 1 is the Udaipur city tour, with the folk performance at Bagore ki Haveli (7 to 8 PM) or the flea market in the evening. Day 2 is the drive to Jawai (3 to 4 hours) for the jeep safari and Jawai Dam. Day 3 covers Bahubali Hills (Badi Lake), Saheliyon ki Bari and Fateh Sagar before you leave by 6 PM, reaching Gurugram on Day 4. Two hotel nights in Udaipur, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners and the safari are included. Prices start at ₹8,000 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).
highlights: Folk performance at Bagore ki Haveli (7 to 8 PM) or the flea market
Fateh Sagar, Saheliyon ki Bari and Bahubali Hills, plus local food

itinerary.title: Departure to Udaipur | Overnight journey
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Gurugram, meet your team captain and the group, and depart in the evening by AC deluxe bus or traveller.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Udaipur city tour
itinerary.content:
Reach Udaipur, check in at the hotel, relax and freshen up.
Sightseeing: Lake Pichola, City Palace, Jagdish Temple and Gangaur Ghat.
In the evening, watch the folk art performance at Bagore ki Haveli (7 to 8 PM) or visit the local flea market.
Back to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Jawai leopard safari
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and have breakfast.
Drive to Jawai (3 to 4 hours) for an adrenaline-rush leopard jeep safari and sightseeing at Jawai Dam.
Return to Udaipur for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Fateh Sagar, Bahubali Hills and departure
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, head out for local sightseeing: Bahubali Hills (Badi Lake), Saheliyon ki Bari and Fateh Sagar Lake. Try Udaipur's local food at the Fateh Sagar market.
Depart for Gurugram by 6 PM, with a halt for dinner (not included). Reach Gurugram on Day 4.
